data.one_liner: A Flutter package that provides 1357 Ionicons icons as IconData constants.
data.what_it_does: It bundles the Ionicons v8.1.0 icon set into a Flutter-friendly API, exposing each icon as a constant that can be used with the Icon widget. The package supports outline, filled, and sharp variants.
use_when: You need a large, cross-platform icon set for a Flutter app.
You want to use Ionicons without pulling the entire web library.
You prefer a simple, no-codegen icon API.
You need both Material and iOS style icons in one package.
avoid_when: You have strict bundle size constraints and want a minimal icon set.
You need icons that are not part of Ionicons or require custom SVG rendering.
strengths: Supports outline, filled, and sharp variants
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Large bundle size for some projects
No support for custom SVG manipulation
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:ionicons/ionicons.dart';
